Tianjin Government Scholarship Program 2022 is an initiative by the Tianjin University of Technology and Education (TUTE) for undergraduate or master's degree applicants who wish to pursue studies at the university. The selected candidates will receive full and partial scholarships.
To be eligible, an applicant must -
Be a non-Chinese citizen and be in good health
Have a senior high school diploma with good academic performance and be under the age of 30
Have a bachelor’s degree and be under the age of 35
The scholarship recipients will benefit from either full or partial scholarship coverage in the following way -
Coverage of registration, tuition, textbook and accommodation fee
Coverage of living allowance and comprehensive medical insurance fee
Coverage of application fees worth up to RMB 400
Cost of learning materials worth up to RMB 500 per academic year
Insurance coverage worth up to RMB 800 per academic year
Accommodation including bathroom, bed, air conditioner, TV, Internet
Study or research plan (not more than 800 words)
Photocopy of Foreigner Physical Examination Form
Follow the steps below to apply for the scholarship:
Fill in the application in the prescribed format, attach a photograph and send the application with the required documents to the following address-
International College, Tianjin University of Technology and Education
No. 1310 Dagu South Road, Hexi District,
The candidates will be selected based on the fulfilment of eligibility criteria.
TUTE will send admission notice and Visa application for Study in China (JW202) to the applicants before July 30th. The applicants can apply for Visa from the Chinese Embassy with these documents.
Transcripts in languages other than Chinese or English must be attached with notarized translations in Chinese or English.
Two letters of recommendation in Chinese or English from professors or associate professors should be submitted.
The study plan should be written in Chinese or in English, in no less than 800 words.
The medical examinations must cover all the items listed in the Foreigner Physical Examination Form.
Incomplete records, those without the signature of the attending physician, the official stamp of the hospital or a sealed photograph of the applicants are invalid.
